settlementToken.name: Mock USDG
settlementToken.faucet: faucet() mints 1000e6 (1,000 tokens) per address per 86400s; FAUCET_AMOUNT/FAUCET_COOLDOWN read on-chain, mintLocked=true so the faucet is the only open supply
settlementToken.verified: 2026-09-13 — source-verified on the explorer as src/mocks/MockUSDG.sol (creation tx 0x78a713a5d9b5d897f47809ead0f8afd540c0a0dae34c47903a028d471756e089, admin 0x0b64B35c6Dd23944D6D4029864D2cA2AA1B66422); live claim tx 0x6e8c867dfb0f9b2b057bac9cbe6fc82979dac7ec701f1b7cdb0af1bc8a4122e6 minted exactly 1000000000 and the immediate retry reverted FaucetCooldown(1789363365)
settlementToken.why: Testnet only, and only because the official testnet USDG drip has never funded a protocol wallet — premiums, vault reserves and payouts have to be exercisable to be verifiable. 6 decimals like USDG, so no protocol math differs; ProtectionNote reads decimals() from vault.token() at runtime.
settlementToken.mainnet: Chain 4663 defaults to canonical USDG 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168, and DeployConfig.settlementToken() reverts MockTokenOnMainnet if the mock is ever paired with 4663. SETTLEMENT_TOKEN overrides either default; switching testnet back to official USDG (0x7E955252E15c84f5768B83c41a71F9eba181802F) is that one env line plus a redeploy.

TSLA.feedType: DemoFeed — owner-set testnet stand-in; Chainlink publishes no feeds on 46630 (mainnet only). NOT market data. Swap to the real Chainlink feed unchanged when available.

demoFeeds.note: Deployed via script/DemoFeed.s.sol, initial prices default $100 (TSLA $250). Only TSLA is registered in the asset registry. Feeds persist across v2/v3/v4 redeploys.

demoNotes.purpose: payout leg: settles below the floor, vault pays max(0, floor - current)
demoNotes.readBack: totalDeposits 50562500 = 50e6 deposit + premium; reserved 20000000; availableCapacity 20450000 = 80% of deposits minus reserved; vault MockUSDG balance 50562500 (custody == accounting, reserved fully backed); buyer 949437500; status ACTIVE; isSettlable false until expiry

settlement.vaultReserved: 10000000 (pre-settle 30000000; note 1's full 20e6 released, the 10e6 left is note 2 still ACTIVE)
settlement.events: ERC20 Transfer vault->buyer 10000000; CapacityReleased(1, 20000000); PayoutExecuted(1, buyer, 10000000); NoteSettled(1, 100e8, 10000000, buyer)
settlement.how: Two cast send calls, not forge script --broadcast. The forge broadcast hung for hours on this device and submitted nothing (its run-latest.json carried no tx hashes and the deployer nonce never moved), so each leg was sent and verified individually.
settlement.baselineNote: Note 1 settled AFTER note 2 existed, so the real post-state is 40843750 deposits / 10000000 reserved / 1959156250 buyer. The 40562500 / 0 / 1959437500 in the original plan predates note 2's 281250 premium and 10e6 reserve.

demoNotes.purpose: no-payout leg: settles at exactly its floor price, so payout = max(0, floor - current) = 0 and only the reserve releases — proves on-chain that the buyer keeps the upside
demoNotes.readBack: nextId 2; reserved 30000000 = 20e6 + 10e6; totalDeposits 50843750 == vault custody; availableCapacity 10675000; buyer 1949156250 = 1949437500 - premium; status ACTIVE

settlement.settlementPrice: 200e8 ($200, DemoFeed raised from $100 before settling — exactly this note's floor, verified by readback before the settle tx)
settlement.vaultTotalDeposits: 40843750 UNCHANGED (a zero payout must not move deposits)
settlement.vaultReserved: 0 (pre-settle 10000000; the full liability released with nothing paid out)
settlement.vaultCustody: 40843750 == totalDeposits — reserved collateral fully backed, now with zero reserve
settlement.buyerMockUSDG: 1959156250 UNCHANGED — the buyer keeps the upside, exactly the product claim
settlement.events: CapacityReleased(2, 10000000) and NoteSettled(2, 200e8, 0, buyer) only — NO PayoutExecuted and NO ERC20 Transfer, which is the point of this leg
settlement.gasNote: settle(2) cost 115848 gas vs settle(1)'s 136151 — the missing transfer is visible in the gas
settlement.bothLegs: Note 1 proved price-below-floor pays; note 2 proved price-at-floor pays nothing while still releasing the reserve. Both settlement branches are now proven end-to-end on live v4.

verification: All four v4 protocol contracts source-verified on the explorer (solc 0.8.35, optimizer 200 runs, constructor args included for the vault and the note; the registry and oracle matched by bytecode).
notes: v4 redeployed for one reason: SherwoodVault.token is immutable, so the v3 vault will forever point at official testnet USDG, a token no protocol wallet has ever received. v3/v2/v1 are abandoned with zero funds and superseded.

Wiring read back from chain after deploy: vault.token() = MockUSDG, vault.noteContract() = the new note, vault.bufferBps() = 2000, note.{registry,oracle,vault} all correct, registry.getAsset(TSLA) = registered + active, vault owner = deployer.
Live read-path proof on v4: quote(0.1 TSLA, 80%, 1d) returned premium 5.625e17 USD-18 ($0.5625) and floor 2e19 ($20.00) — identical to v3 and to the spec formula at the DemoFeed price of $250.
Position guard is unchanged in v4 (create() reverts InsufficientPosition unless the caller holds the protected stock); proven on-chain in the v3 simulation on 2026-09-12 and covered by tests since.

Frontend is repointed at this stack: v4 addresses and MockUSDG are the built-in defaults in frontend/lib/addresses.ts (mirrored in the gitignored frontend/.env.local), and `npm run build` was verified with no env file present, so a Vercel deploy needs no configuration.

Demo write path executed 2026-09-13: script/DemoCreate.s.sol funded the vault with 50 MockUSDG and bought note 1 (0.1 TSLA, $250 entry, 80%, 1 day) entirely in MockUSDG, paid from the 1,000 claimed from its faucet. Settlement is the remaining step — run script/DemoSettle.s.sol with NOTE_ID=1 after expiry (Mon 2026-09-14 ~08:16 WAT).

Deploy note for this chain: forge script needs --private-key passed explicitly for --broadcast; relying on the PRIVATE_KEY env var alone left the broadcast using Foundry's default sender and nothing was signed (the first v4 attempt produced zero deployed code). Dry runs need --sender set to the deployer too, or the DemoFeed's onlyOwner check reverts NotOwner. Expect an EIP-3855/PUSH0 warning for chain 46630 — v1 through v4 all deployed and execute fine.
